strings.d1.s0.name: Charles Bridge
strings.d1.s0.tips: 14th-century bridge with 30 statues. It is empty before 8 am. Touch the statue of St John of Nepomuk.
strings.d1.s1.name: Old Town Square
strings.d1.s1.tips: Týn Church and the Jan Hus Monument. The Astronomical Clock performs every hour from 09:00 to 23:00 (the 12 apostles).
strings.d1.s2.name: Old Town Hall Tower
strings.d1.s2.tips: Tower with a lift. Panoramic views over the square, no queue in the morning.
strings.d1.s3.name: Jewish Quarter Josefov
strings.d1.s3.tips: Old-New Synagogue, Old Jewish Cemetery (12,000 gravestones) and Pinkas Synagogue. Closed on Saturdays.
strings.d1.s4.name: Lokál Dlouhá
strings.d1.s4.tips: Beer from the best Pilsner Urquell tank, plus svíčková (beef in cream sauce) and goulash in a classic Czech canteen.
strings.d1.b0.name: Sisters Bistro
strings.d1.b1.name: Klementinum
strings.d1.b1.tips: Baroque library and astronomical tower. Swap for Josefov.
strings.d2.s0.name: Prague Castle
strings.d2.s0.tips: The world's largest castle complex. See St Vitus Cathedral (Mucha stained glass), the Old Royal Palace and Golden Lane (Kafka's house at No. 22). Arrive at the 09:00 opening. Tickets are timed in summer, and there is a security check at the gate.
strings.d2.s1.name: Malá Strana Walk
strings.d2.s1.tips: Look for the house signs on Nerudova Street, and the dome of the Baroque Church of St Nicholas.
strings.d2.s2.name: U Modré Kachničky
strings.d2.s2.tips: The Blue Duck: goose and duck are Bohemian classics, in Malá Strana.
strings.d2.s3.name: Kampa Island & Museum
strings.d2.s3.tips: River island park with David Černý's babies and the Kampa Museum (Kupka), 350 CZK.
strings.d2.s4.name: Petřín Hill Funicular & Tower
strings.d2.s4.tips: Winter sunset is at 16:30. See the lit-up city from the tower.
strings.d2.b0.name: Café Savoy
strings.d2.b0.tips: 1893 café with an ornate ceiling, in Malá Strana.
strings.d2.b1.name: Strahov Monastery Library
strings.d2.b1.tips: Baroque library and beer. Swap for Petřín.
strings.d3.s0.name: Vyšehrad
strings.d3.s0.tips: Hilltop fort that predates Prague Castle. See Slavín Cemetery (Dvořák, Mucha), the Rotunda and river views. Free.
strings.d3.s1.name: Vinohradský Parlament
strings.d3.s1.tips: Czech restaurant in Vinohrady. Try vepřo knedlo zelo (pork, dumplings and cabbage).
strings.d3.s2.name: Riegrovy Sady
strings.d3.s2.tips: Winter park walk with views of the castle.
strings.d3.s3.name: Žižkov Television Tower
strings.d3.s3.tips: Černý's climbing babies and a 93 m observation deck.
strings.d3.s4.name: U Slovanské Lípy
strings.d3.s4.tips: Old Žižkov pub with 10+ beer tanks and pork knuckle.
strings.d3.b0.name: Kavárna Slavia
strings.d3.b0.tips: Riverside café from 1884, opposite the National Theatre.
strings.d3.b1.name: National Museum
strings.d3.b1.tips: At the top of Wenceslas Square, with a dome. Swap for Žižkov.
strings.d4.s0.name: Sedlec Ossuary
strings.d4.s0.tips: 1 hour by train (Hlavní). Chandelier and coat of arms made from 40,000 skeletons (the Bone Church). Book tickets online. No photography.
strings.d4.s1.name: St. Barbara's Cathedral
strings.d4.s1.tips: Gothic cathedral of the silver miners. UNESCO-listed, with a terrace at the Jesuit College.
strings.d4.s2.name: Kutná Hora Historic Centre
strings.d4.s2.tips: Medieval streets, the Stone Fountain and the Italian Court (the mint).
strings.d4.s3.name: Dačický Kutná Hora
strings.d4.s3.tips: Medieval beer hall with local beer and duck.
strings.d4.s4.name: Czech Museum of Silver Hrádek
strings.d4.s4.tips: Descend into a medieval silver mine (helmet and apron provided). Guided tour, then the train back.
strings.d4.b0.name: Karlštejn Castle
strings.d4.b0.tips: Charles IV's Gothic castle, 40 minutes by train. Swap for Kutná Hora (closed on Mondays).
strings.d4.b1.name: Pivnice Dačický Bahçe
strings.d4.b1.tips: The garden of the same venue. Sausages.
strings.d5.s0.name: Letná Park Metronome
strings.d5.s0.tips: Metronome on the site of the former Stalin statue. Views of the bridges, and a beer garden in summer.
strings.d5.s1.name: National Technical Museum
strings.d5.s1.tips: Aeroplanes, trains and vintage cars, in Letná.
strings.d5.s2.name: Holešovice Market Hall
strings.d5.s2.tips: Pražská tržnice: Vietnamese pho and Czech food stalls.
strings.d5.s3.name: DOX Centre for Contemporary Art
strings.d5.s3.tips: Contemporary art and a rooftop airship, in Holešovice.
strings.d5.s4.name: Stromovka Park
strings.d5.s4.tips: Former royal hunting park with ponds and a planetarium.
strings.d5.b0.name: Prague Zoo
strings.d5.b0.tips: One of Europe's best zoos (Troja). Swap for DOX and Stromovka.
strings.d5.b1.name: Bistro 8 Letná
strings.d6.s0.name: Český Krumlov Castle
strings.d6.s0.tips: RegioJet bus, 3 hours (Florenc, about 200 CZK, leave at 07:00). A UNESCO town in a bend of the Vltava with the country's 2nd-largest castle. Tower 180 CZK, Baroque theatre tour.
strings.d6.s1.name: Castle Garden Český Krumlov
strings.d6.s1.tips: Cascading garden and a revolving auditorium theatre.
strings.d6.s2.name: Krčma v Šatlavské
strings.d6.s2.tips: Medieval dungeon tavern serving meat cooked over an open fire.
strings.d6.s3.name: Český Krumlov Old Town
strings.d6.s3.tips: Latrán and the main square, plus the Egon Schiele Art Centrum (200 CZK).
strings.d6.s4.name: Vltava Rafting Krumlov
strings.d6.s4.tips: In winter, walk along the river and enjoy the view of the Cloak Bridge.
strings.d6.b0.name: Papa's Living Restaurant Krumlov
strings.d6.b1.name: Hluboká Castle
strings.d6.b1.tips: White castle resembling Windsor. An alternative on the way to Krumlov.
strings.d7.s0.name: Wenceslas Square
strings.d7.s0.tips: Square of the 1989 Velvet Revolution. The National Museum is at the top, and the upside-down horse is in the Lucerna arcade.
strings.d7.s1.name: Havelské Tržiště
strings.d7.s1.tips: Market in the Old Town for souvenirs and fruit. Go to Moser for Bohemian crystal.
strings.d7.s2.name: Café Louvre
strings.d7.s2.tips: 1902 café (Kafka, Einstein). Have a farewell breakfast and play billiards.
strings.d7.s3.name: Hlavní Nádraží Airport Bus
strings.d7.s3.tips: AE bus takes 35 minutes, or take the metro plus bus 119. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Trdelník Stand Old Town
strings.d7.b0.tips: Trdelník (sweet rolled pastry) with ice cream. Touristy but tasty. Farewell treat.
strings.d7.b1.name: Mucha Museum
strings.d7.b1.tips: Art nouveau posters. Swap for the market.
strings.note0: A Lítačka 24-hour ticket costs 120 CZK (tram, metro, funicular). The centre is walkable. The AE bus to the airport costs 100 CZK. Use Bolt or Uber instead of taxis.
strings.note1: Christmas markets run in December (Old Town Square, 1 December to 6 January). Winter temperatures range from -3 to 3°C, with snow. The castle and bridge are quiet, and Kutná Hora is peaceful.
strings.note2: Beer costs 50-70 CZK (cheaper than water), goulash 200-250, svíčková 250, croissant and coffee 100. Tip 10%. A cover charge is sometimes added to the bill.
strings.note3: Beware of exchange offices advertising 0% commission (bad rate). At ATMs, choose your own bank's rate. If you are offered payment in EUR, the rate is poor. Cards are accepted everywhere.
strings.note4: Castle main circuit 450 CZK. Josefov is closed on Saturdays. Book Sedlec Ossuary tickets online, no photography. Buy your Krumlov bus ticket from RegioJet days in advance.
strings.note5: Trdelník is not Czech (Hungarian/Slovak) but it is tasty. Truly Czech dishes: svíčková, vepřo knedlo zelo, smažený sýr (fried cheese), koláče (sweet pastries).
